verdict.rationale: No first-party doc describes a native chat or messaging feature. One community user says their team used Asana itself for remote team communication and never needed Slack, and the Slack integration mentions comments in Asana, which suggests task-level discussion rather than real-time chat. Missing for 10: documented native team chat/messaging (direct or channel messages), real-time conversation features, first-party docs on in-app communication, and corroboration beyond a single anecdote.
